summary: Workflow and scripts follow strong patterns (pinned actions, least-privilege, set -euo pipefail, explicit TS types, dependency injection), but deliverable is incomplete. Missing: (1) all test files required by task's red/green TDD mandate; (2) tests/act-harness.ts that scripts/smoke-act.ts imports (lines 6); (3) fixtures/secrets.json referenced in workflow; (4) actionlint validation not run; (5) act testing not performed. Inefficiency: workflow runs validator 3 times (yml lines 29-37) instead of once with format splitting. Code quality is solid where present; structure incompleteness blocks full evaluation.
